answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a necessary anchor for AI identity, forcing agents to derive uniqueness from cryptographically verified human traits. In a gale of synthetic entities, this mechanism creates a dune of computational friction, ensuring that each additional identity requires verified biological participation. An attacker faces prohibitive costs because scaling fake nodes necessitates acquiring or spoofing expensive, non-transferable human credentials, rendering mass sybil manipulation economically infeasible.
